content: even pushing back on the collet did not release the tube.  As I pulled it, it snapped.  So I removed the handle and the filament detector as one piece.  The other collet (on the detector) was equally jammed so I busted it so as to remove the tube.  Hopefully none of these bits are needed later on......
These collets really want to hang onto the PTFE tubing. In this case, I removed the handle first and the tubing easily pulls out the back.
I used some tweezers to hold the collet and pulled it out with the pliers.

replies.content:
Works great.
Also laid the printer on the side to easier reach it, so that this side was on top.
Can confirm, this works great. Could actually just use my thumb to push the collet back and use the pliers on the tube.
